style: cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-quality, slapstick, deadpan, hard midday sun
shot: single locked-off low angle, one slow push-in only in the final beat
character: PIG: plump pink pig, deadpan heavy-lidded eyes, blinks slowly, dusty builder's apron; trotters grip/sweep/count/pin; gait is a happy appetizing waddle-limp when she moves
cast: GOAT: shaggy grey-and-white goat, small stubby horns, blank chewing gaze, jaw grinding sideways nonstop; large, close to lens, never speaks
props: trough of kitchen scraps, front and center, pig snout-deep in it. Torn palace blueprint pinned to a single post behind her, corner already ripped and flapping. Apron hem hangs loose at her side, ready to wipe
setting: yard by an unfinished house foundation, midday, hard sun, concrete slab, packed dirt, same yard as before

audio.delivery: male low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry unrushed flat deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: one sentence only, unrushed tempo, no pause inside it
audio.lip_sync: pig talks like a person, mouth opens and closes clearly every syllable, voice is the pig's own, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wet chomping and slurping, satisfied grunt, loud burp, paper tearing and being chewed, goat bleat

timeline.a: silent. Snout buried in the trough, wet chomping, tail wagging hard with appetite; torn blueprint flaps on the post behind her
silent. Waddle-limps one step sideways along the trough, snout still down, still chewing hard
silent. Straightens up, snout and cheeks dripping, chewing slows to a stop
silent. Grabs the apron hem, wipes snout and cheeks with it, smearing more than cleaning
silent. Chest puffs, loud burp, apron falls back to her side
mouth moves, satisfied deadpan look toward the blueprint on the post, eyes half-closed
silent. Goat trots in from the right, beelines straight for the blueprint on the post
silent. Goat locks its teeth onto the torn corner, plants its hooves, starts pulling
silent. Pig glances sideways at the goat, unbothered, blinks slowly, snout drifts back toward the trough
silent. Goat rips the blueprint off the post whole, paper crumpling in its teeth, chewing hard
silent. Pig gives one small shrug of the trotters, turns fully back to the trough
silent. Snout dips back into the trough, chomping resumes; goat behind her swallows the last scrap of paper, one final satisfied chew
timeline.cam: only camera move in the clip: slow push-in on her snout in the trough, ending the shot

must_appear: pig chomping snout-down in the trough; torn palace blueprint flapping on the post behind her; apron hem wiping her snout and cheeks; the burp; goat arriving and tearing the blueprint off the post; goat chewing and swallowing the paper whole
negative_prompt: night, dusk, evening light, lamp, dim, moody, low key, low-key, dark scene, candle, neon, underexposed; second pig, second goat, other animals; duplicate trough, post, or apron; floating objects, props stacked in tiers; camera movement besides the single push-in; cuts, jump cuts; extra limbs; human hands; costume changes; rushed delivery, drawn-out delivery, pauses mid-sentence, foreign accent, English speech; subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, readable text on the blueprint
